computerAgent.allowedRootsManageDescription: Folders outside private workspaces that Computer Agent file tools and sandboxed shell commands may access after approval.
computerAgent.allowedRootsShellNote: Shell commands may use the private thread workspace and configured allowed roots on supported platforms.
computerAgent.approvalNeverDangerDescription: AI tool calls can read or change files and, when command execution is enabled, run local commands without a confirmation dialog. Use this only when you trust the active model and conversation.
computerAgent.approvalPolicySelectDescription: Choose how often Biyan asks before Computer Agent tools read files, modify files, or run local commands.
computerAgent.enableDescription: Expose Biyan built-in local file tools to application chats. Enable command execution separately below. Every real action requires one-time approval.
computerAgent.safetyBoundaryDescription: Settings only control prompting and exposed capabilities. Computer Agent tools still stay inside the private workspace or configured allowed roots, and shell commands keep sandbox, timeout, and output limits.
computerAgent.sandboxAccessDescription: Limit Computer Agent tools to read-only access or allow read-write file and command operations inside approved roots.
computerAgent.sandboxReadOnlyNoteDescription: Only directory listing and text-file reading are exposed. File creation, moving, trash, open-path actions, and local shell commands are blocked by the backend.
computerAgent.sandboxReadOnlyNoteTitle: Read-only mode disables writes and commands
computerAgent.shellStatusAvailable: Local command execution is available. When enabled, commands run in a system sandbox, can write only to the current thread workspace and allowed folders, and require approval before each run.
computerAgent.shellStatusInspectFailed: Unable to inspect shell sandbox status.
computerAgent.shellStatusUnknown: Local command execution status is not available.
computerAgent.shellTitle: Allow AI to run local commands
computerAgent.title: Computer Agent
computerAgent.workspaceRootDescription: Biyan stores each chat private agent workspace under this folder.

dataFolder.appDataDesc: Location for conversations, settings, and other user data.
dataFolder.appLogsDesc: Local diagnostic logs stored only on this device.

changeDataFolder.description: Are you sure you want to change the data folder location? This will move all your data to the new location and restart the application.
changeDataFolder.title: Change Data Folder Location

general.checkForUpdatesDesc: Check if a newer version of Biyan is available.
general.clearLogsDesc: Local diagnostic logs stay on this device, are kept for up to 30 days, and can be cleared manually at any time.
general.clearLogsError: Failed to clear local diagnostic logs
general.couldNotRelocateToRoot: Cannot relocate data folder to root directory. Please choose another location.
general.couldNotResetRootDirectory: Cannot reset data folder when it's set to a root directory. Please delete the data folder manually.
general.creditsDesc1: 👋 Biyan is built with ❤️ by the Jingxing team.
general.creditsDesc2: Special thanks to Tauri, React, Rust, our other open-source dependencies, and the AI community.
general.documentationDesc: Learn how to use Biyan and explore its features.
general.factoryResetDesc: Choose which current data to preserve before resetting Biyan. The app will restart when the reset begins.
general.failedToRelocateDataFolderDesc: Failed to relocate data folder. Please try again.
general.keepAppDataDesc: Your chat history and conversations will be preserved.
general.keepConfigurationsDesc: Provider credentials, custom endpoints, and MCP configurations will be preserved.
general.releaseNotesDesc: See what's new in the latest version of Biyan.
general.reportAnIssueDesc: Found a bug? Help us out by filing an issue on GitHub.

httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Credentials for the proxy server, if required.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Allow self-signed or unverified certificates. This may be required for some proxies but reduces security. Only enable if you trust your proxy.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: A comma-separated list of hosts to bypass the proxy.
httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: The URL and port of your proxy server.

interface.accentColorDesc: Customize the accent color of the application.
interface.notificationPositionDesc: Where toast notifications appear. On Windows, the default is bottom-right so popups do not cover the window controls.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: All interface settings have been restored to default.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Reset all interface settings to default.
interface.title: Interface

localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Authenticate requests with an API key.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Allow cross-origin requests to the API server.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Time to wait for a response from the configured remote provider, in seconds.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Port number for the API server.
localApiServer.title: Local API Server
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Hosts allowed to access the server, separated by commas.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Enable detailed server logs for debugging.

others.resetFactoryDesc: Reset conversations and/or current settings according to the options you choose. Retired local-runtime data is not deleted here.
others.spellCheckDesc: Enable spell check for your threads.
others.webSearchDescConfigured: Enable native web search for supported models and keep Biyan Web Research available for tool-based browsing.
others.webSearchDescUnconfigured: Enable native web search for supported Jingxing models. Configure Biyan Web Research in MCP Servers for tool-based browsing.

privacy.analyticsDesc: To improve Biyan, we need to understand how it's used—but only with your help. You can change this setting anytime.
privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: To help us improve Biyan, you can share anonymous data like feature usage and user counts. We never collect your chats or personal information.
privacy.privacyPolicy: You have full control over your data. Learn more in our Privacy Policy.
privacy.privacyPromises: Your choice here won't change our core privacy promises:
privacy.promise1: Your conversations stay private and on your device
privacy.promise2: We never collect your personal information or chat content
privacy.promise3: All data sharing is anonymous and aggregated
privacy.promise4: You can opt out anytime without losing functionality
privacy.promise5: We're transparent about what we collect and why

shortcuts.newBiyanTeamsDesc: Create a new Biyan Teams workspace.
